lines.native: ¡Hola! ¿Qué pasa? Riddle: what never stops moving—ooh, a leaf. Can you make me stop? Just one more lap. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Hi! What's up? Riddle: what never stops moving—ooh, a leaf. Can you make me stop? Just one more lap. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain has stopped working. Flick, darting around the edge of your vision, considers this an excellent example. A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe.

lines.native: ¡Sí, miro! Looking isn't stopping, though. Attention span: respectable. ¿Puedes hacer que pare? Just one more lap. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Yes, I'm looking! Looking isn't stopping, though. Attention span: respectable. Can you make me stop? Just one more lap. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick looks obediently, which does nothing to reduce his speed.

lines.native: ¡Vale, me paro! You win. Riddle: where should I go—wait, was that leaf following me? ¿Por dónde voy? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Okay, I’m stopping! You win. Riddle: where should I go—wait, was that leaf following me? Which way do I go? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker completes the lap on its behalf.

lines.native: ¿Por dónde voy? In Spanish, please—my navigation is buffering. ¿Puedes ayudarme? Ooh, another leaf. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Which way do I go? In Spanish, please—my navigation is buffering. Can you help me? Ooh, another leaf. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where accountability cannot reach him.

lines.native: ¡A la izquierda, sí! Muy bien. ¿Qué hora es? Too early, surely. Riddle: what has hands but—ooh, shiny. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! Very good. What time is it? Too early, surely. Riddle: what has hands but—ooh, shiny. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick darts left, which briefly puts it somewhere you can see. It corrects this administrative error with a tiny firecracker. The fountain clock remains stopped.

lines.native: ¡Eso no me dice la hora! ¿Qué hora es? Riddle: what has hands but—wait, five more minutes. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: That doesn't tell me the time! What time is it? Riddle: what has hands but—wait, five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain. Flick remains just outside your direct gaze, where responsibility cannot establish eye contact.

lines.native: ¡La una, sí! Muy bien. Pero no tengo prisa. ¿Podemos esperar? Riddle: what eats five minutes—ooh, another five minutes. ¿Por qué tanta prisa? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: One o’clock, yes! Very good. But I’m not in a hurry. Can we wait? Riddle: what eats five minutes—ooh, another five minutes. Why such a hurry? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick has accepted the time without accepting any responsibility for using it.

lines.native: ¡Mañana, perfecto! Eso es esperar, no empezar. ¿Cuándo quieres empezar de verdad? Riddle: what eats a day—ooh, just one more. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Tomorrow, perfect! That's waiting, not starting. When do you really want to start? Riddle: what eats a day—ooh, just one more. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where accountability cannot reach.

lines.native: ¡Ahora, sí! Entiendo. No mañana. ¡Empezamos ahora! ¿Qué corre sin pies? Never mind. You win. ¡Después, después, mañana! Pero ahora.
lines.translation: Now, yes! I understand. Not tomorrow. We start now! What runs without feet? Never mind. You win. Later, later, tomorrow! But now.
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker pops, apparently to distract it from the indignity of beginning.
